records.title: No choice but to — 〜ざるを得ない
records.english: We have no choice but to cancel the trip.
records.notes: ない-stem + ざるを得ない = have no choice but to. 行く → 行かざるを得ない; する → せざるを得ない.

exercises.jp: 台風/が/来る/ので/旅行/は/中止/せざるを得ない
exercises.en: A typhoon is coming, so we have no choice but to cancel the trip.

exercises.jp: 部長/の/命令/なら/従わざるを得ない
exercises.en: If it's the manager's order, I have no choice but to obey.

exercises.jp: 電車/が/止まった/ので/歩いて/帰らざるを得なかった
exercises.en: The trains stopped, so I had no choice but to walk home.
distractors: 帰るざるを得なかった

exercises.jp: 予算/が/足りない/ので/計画/を/変更/せざるを得ない
exercises.en: The budget isn't enough, so we have no choice but to change the plan.
also: 計画を予算が足りないので変更せざるを得ない

exercises.jp: 熱/が/ある/ので/試合/を/休まざるを得ない
exercises.en: I have a fever, so I have no choice but to miss the match.

records.title: Can't very well — 〜わけにはいかない
records.english: There's an important meeting, so I can't very well take the day off.
records.notes: Dictionary form + わけにはいかない = can't (for social or moral reasons). ない-form + わけにはいかない = have to.

exercises.jp: 大事な/会議/が/ある/ので/休む/わけにはいかない
exercises.en: There's an important meeting, so I can't very well take the day off.

exercises.jp: 車/で/来た/ので/お酒/を/飲む/わけにはいかない
exercises.en: I came by car, so I can't very well drink alcohol.

exercises.jp: 約束/した/以上/行かない/わけにはいかない
exercises.en: Now that I've promised, I have to go.

exercises.jp: 先輩/の/頼み/なので/断る/わけにはいかない
exercises.en: It's a senior colleague's request, so I can't very well refuse.

exercises.jp: これ/は/秘密/なので/話す/わけにはいかない
exercises.en: This is a secret, so I can't very well tell you.

records.title: As… so… — 〜につれて
records.english: As I've got older, my stamina has dropped.
records.notes: Dictionary form / noun + につれて = as A changes, B changes with it. Both sides describe gradual change.

exercises.jp: 年/を/とる/につれて/体力/が/落ちて/きた
exercises.en: As I've got older, my stamina has dropped.

exercises.jp: 日本語/が/上手/に/なる/につれて/生活/が/楽しく/なった
exercises.en: As my Japanese improved, life became more fun.

exercises.jp: 時間/が/たつ/につれて/悲しみ/は/薄れて/いった
exercises.en: As time passed, the sadness faded.

exercises.jp: 町/が/発展/する/につれて/人口/が/増えた
exercises.en: As the town developed, the population grew.

exercises.jp: 山/を/登る/につれて/気温/が/下がって/いく
exercises.en: As you climb the mountain, the temperature goes down.

records.title: After (and based on) — 〜た上で
records.english: I'll give you my answer after thinking it over carefully.
records.notes: た-form / noun + の + 上で = after doing, and on that basis, do the next thing. Formal; common in business.

exercises.jp: よく/考えた/上で/お返事/します
exercises.en: I'll give you my answer after thinking it over carefully.

exercises.jp: 両親/と/相談/した/上で/決めます
exercises.en: I'll decide after talking it over with my parents.

exercises.jp: 内容/を/確認/した/上で/サイン/して/ください
exercises.en: Please sign after checking the contents.

exercises.jp: 説明/を/聞いた/上で/申し込む/つもり/です
exercises.en: I plan to apply after hearing the explanation.

exercises.jp: 話し合い/の/上で/方針/を/決定/します
exercises.en: We'll decide the policy after discussing it.

records.title: Although — 〜ものの
records.english: Although I got my licence, I haven't driven even once.
records.notes: Plain form + ものの = although (it's true), the expected result didn't follow. Written, a little formal.

exercises.jp: 免許/は/取った/ものの/まだ/一度/も/運転/して/いない
exercises.en: Although I got my licence, I haven't driven even once.

exercises.jp: 頭/で/は/分かって/いる/ものの/なかなか/やめられない
exercises.en: Although I know it in my head, I just can't stop.

exercises.jp: パソコン/を/買った/ものの/使い方/が/分からない
exercises.en: Although I bought a computer, I don't know how to use it.

exercises.jp: 引き受けた/ものの/自信/が/ない
exercises.en: Although I took it on, I'm not confident.

exercises.jp: 春/に/なった/ものの/まだ/寒い/日/が/続いて/いる
exercises.en: Although spring has come, cold days continue.

records.title: Not necessarily — 〜とは限らない
records.english: Expensive things aren't necessarily good things.
records.notes: Plain form + とは限らない = it isn't always so. Often paired with 必ずしも or からといって.

exercises.jp: 高い/物/が/必ずしも/いい/物/だ/とは限らない
exercises.en: Expensive things aren't necessarily good things.

exercises.jp: 有名な/店/が/おいしい/とは限らない
exercises.en: Famous restaurants aren't necessarily tasty.

exercises.jp: 先生/の/言う/こと/が/いつも/正しい/とは限らない
exercises.en: What the teacher says isn't always right.

exercises.jp: 練習/すれば/必ず/勝てる/とは限らない
exercises.en: Practising doesn't necessarily mean you'll win.

exercises.jp: 日本人/だ/から/といって/敬語/が/上手/だ/とは限らない
exercises.en: Just because someone is Japanese doesn't mean they're good at keigo.

records.title: Precisely because — 〜からこそ
records.english: It's precisely because I worry about you that I'm strict.
records.notes: Plain form + からこそ = precisely because (this, and nothing else). Stresses a positive or surprising reason.

exercises.jp: 心配/して/いる/からこそ/厳しく/言う/のです
exercises.en: It's precisely because I worry about you that I'm being strict.

exercises.jp: 失敗/した/からこそ/学べた/こと/も/ある
exercises.en: There are things I could learn precisely because I failed.

exercises.jp: 毎日/練習/した/からこそ/合格/できた
exercises.en: It's precisely because I practised every day that I passed.

exercises.jp: 家族/が/いる/からこそ/頑張れる
exercises.en: It's precisely because I have a family that I can keep going.

exercises.jp: 難しい/からこそ/やる/価値/が/ある
exercises.en: It's precisely because it's difficult that it's worth doing.

records.title: As long as — 〜さえ〜ば
records.english: If only I had the time, I'd travel more.
records.notes: Noun + さえ + ば-form = as long as just this one thing. Verbs: ます-stem + さえすれば (飲みさえすれば).

exercises.jp: 時間/さえ/あれば/もっと/旅行/したい
exercises.en: If only I had the time, I'd travel more.

exercises.jp: この/薬/を/飲み/さえ/すれば/すぐ/治ります
exercises.en: As long as you take this medicine, you'll get better soon.

exercises.jp: 天気/さえ/よければ/富士山/が/見えます
exercises.en: As long as the weather is good, you can see Mt Fuji.

exercises.jp: お金/さえ/あれば/幸せ/だ/とは限らない
exercises.en: Having money doesn't necessarily make you happy.

exercises.jp: 住所/さえ/分かれば/荷物/を/送れます
exercises.en: As long as I know the address, I can send the parcel.
